asked.item: Post the same posts to a Facebook Group automatically
Is there a setting or Facebook-side approval I'm missing

verdict.reason: The help pages state Blotato cannot post to Facebook Groups because Facebook's API does not allow it, so no setting or approval changes that.

steps.text: Blotato can't post to Facebook Groups, so no setting or approval on your side enables it.
Facebook's API does not let third-party tools post to Facebook Groups, and Blotato publishes to Facebook Pages only.
